title: Estimate Fees, Validity Windows and Authorisation Thresholds by Service Level
content:
# Desk Standing Rule: Estimate Fees, Validity Windows and Authorisation Thresholds by Service Level

Each service level of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service fixes whether the bench estimate is prepared free of charge, how long that estimate stays good, the estimate total above which the customer's authorisation is needed before work starts, the total above which that authorisation must be in writing, and whether a deposit is taken. The desk reads these from the level the work order runs at.

| Level figure | Standard Bench Service | Priority Bench Service | Master Jeweler Service | Heritage Restoration Service | Designer Authorized Repair Service | Atelier White-Glove Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Estimate prepared free of charge | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no |
| Estimate fee where charged, USD | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 85.00 | 95.00 | 250.00 |
| Estimate fee credited against the work when the customer goes ahead | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Estimate stays good for, calendar days | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 60 | 90 |
| Authorisation required above an estimate total of, USD | 75.00 | 100.00 | 150.00 | 200.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 |
| Authorisation must be in writing above an estimate total of, USD | 500.00 | 750.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Deposit share of the authorised total, percent | 0 | 0 | 25 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Deposit taken at all only above an authorised total of, USD | 999999.00 | 999999.00 | 750.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 1500.00 |

## Points of judgement on the table

- At the three levels where the estimate is free, the estimate fee is 0.00 USD and nothing is credited against the work. At Heritage Restoration Service, Designer Authorized Repair Service and Atelier White-Glove Service the estimate carries the fee shown and that fee is credited against the work when the customer goes ahead.
- The validity window is counted in calendar days.
- The authorisation threshold and the written-authorisation threshold are each an estimate total *above* which the requirement applies: an estimate total equal to the threshold does not pass it.
- The deposit threshold is an authorised total *above* which a deposit is taken; at Standard Bench Service and Priority Bench Service the threshold stands at 999999.00 USD and the deposit share at 0 percent.

## Hypothetical readings

A hypothetical Master Jeweler Service estimate of 150.00 USD is not above the level's 150.00 USD authorisation threshold; one of 150.01 USD is. A hypothetical Heritage Restoration Service estimate of 1600.00 USD is above the level's 1500.00 USD written-authorisation threshold, while one of 1500.00 USD is not. A hypothetical Atelier White-Glove Service authorised total of 1500.00 USD is not above the level's 1500.00 USD deposit threshold, so no deposit is taken on it; at 1500.01 USD a deposit of 50 percent is taken.
